title: Towards Enabling Hostile Multi-tenancy in Kubernetes
problem: Kubernetes native constructs (namespaces, RBAC) provide logical separation but lack strong isolation guarantees for hostile multi-tenancy
motivation: Enable secure, zero-trust Kubernetes deployments in untrusted, adversarial cloud/edge environments
method: Per-tenant virtual control planes (vCluster); VM-based container sandboxes (Azure Container Instances); policy engine (Kyverno) for automated hardening
key_novelty: Kubernetes-compatible hostile multi-tenancy architecture combining virtual control planes and VM-backed sandboxes; negligible performance overhead
contributions: Per-tenant virtual control plane design for Kubernetes
VM-based sandbox architecture for container isolation
Automated policy enforcement with Kyverno for namespace hardening
limitations: Evaluation details limited in abstract; scalability to large number of tenants not explored; Azure-specific implementation may limit portability
primary_theme: Secure container orchestration for hostile environments
